question: Regarding vaccination with rubella vaccine in pregnant women, point out the correct answer:

options.opa: It should be encouraged as it is very convenient for Public Health.
options.opb: It is the procedure of choice for the control of congenital rubella syndrome.
options.opc: It is no longer considered as an indication of abortion.
options.opd: It is allowed in the case of vaccines of strain RA 27/3, but not in the case of vaccines of the strain Cendehill.
options.ope: It must be administered in conjunction with specific immunoglobulin
